title: Project
description: The project a repository is rendered for: its names, its Go module, who holds its copyright and under what licence, and the options that add files.

name.title: Name
name.description: The project's name, which is its command's name: lower-case letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter. It names cmd/<name>/, and without its hyphens it names the Go package under internal/, so without its hyphens it is not a Go keyword and not main.

module.title: Module path
module.description: The Go module path: a domain the owner controls, then at least one path element, such as example.com/weather.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the command does, in one line with no final full stop, as the README's first line and the command's doc comment say it.
examples: Prints the weather for a place

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Who holds the copyright: a person's or an organisation's name, as each Go file's copyright line and the README name it.

year.title: Copyright year
year.description: The year each Go file's copyright line and the README give: the year the repository is created.

license.title: Licence
license.description: The SPDX identifier of the project's licence, such as Apache-2.0 or MIT, or a LicenseRef- identifier for terms of the owner's own. Each Go file's SPDX-License-Identifier line and the README name it; no licence text is written.

go.title: Go version
go.description: The Go release the module is written for, as go.mod's go line and the CI workflow name it.

commands.title: Extra commands
commands.description: Further commands the repository holds beside the project's own, each in cmd/<name>/, listed once each. No two may share a name, and none may take the project's.

name.title: Command name
name.description: The command's name, which names its directory under cmd/.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What the command does, in one line with no final full stop.
examples: Loads observations into the weather store
Writes the weather store out as CSV

ci.title: CI workflow
ci.description: Whether the repository holds .github/workflows/ci.yml, which runs scripts/check.sh on every push and pull request.

container.title: Container build
container.description: Whether the repository holds a Dockerfile and a .dockerignore that build the command into an image.
